findings.message: ProductGroup at `$['data']` has `2` variants with no declared per-variant `url`s. If each variant is genuinely reachable at its own address — its own page or a variant-selecting parameter — declare it in the variant's `url` field; a fragment `@id` identifies the variant but does not promise it is addressable.
findings.remediation: For each variant entry in `hasVariant`, add a `url` field with the variant's addressable URL — its own page (case 3) or the shared page with its variant-selecting query parameter (case 2). If all variants share the exact same URL with no parameter-based differentiation (case 1), the per-variant `url` field can be omitted.
